subject: Post-call: volume bands, budget range & startup incentive request
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Tran <sophie@lumenai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + ask: token bands, budget range, startup incentive

Hi Sophie — great to speak earlier. Quick recap and the asks we talked through on the call so we can move to a pricing proposal: 

1) Current and expected token volumes
- Please confirm an expected baseline and a 6–12 month spike profile (monthly tokens). From the call I heard ~1M–1.5M tokens/mo baseline and spikes to ~4–6M in peak days — can you confirm?

2) Target economical goal ($ / 1M tokens)
- You mentioned a target around ~$900–$1,000 per 1M tokens in the initial phase. Is that a hard target or a stretch? Any internal ceiling we should be aware of?

3) Budget cadence and range
- For procurement planning, what is your monthly or quarterly budget range for inference (ballpark is fine). You mentioned $10k–$25k/mo as a starting point — can you confirm committed vs experimental budget?

4) Discount preference and commitment appetite
- Are you primarily looking for a startup path (credit + lighter commit) or would you consider a 12–24 month committed tier for a deeper unit rate? If you have preferred term length or procurement constraints, flag them.

Next steps from our side: once we have the volume band and target $/1M token, Ben will draft 2–3 pricing scenarios (starter + committed 12mo + multi-year) with explicit unit economics and invoice cadence. 

If you have any usage exports or a short burn CSV, please attach — it helps speed the unit-econ calc.

Thanks — Avery

--
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0194
[Attachment: call-recording-20261009.mp3 (audio, 1.2MB)]
From: Sophie Tran <sophie@lumenai.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: LumenAI Procurement <procurement@lumenai.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 17:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + ask: token bands, budget range, startup incentive

Thanks Avery — quick answers below and I've attached a projection workbook for reference.

Baseline & spikes
- Baseline: ~1.2M tokens / month for current internal tooling.
- Expected growth: ramp to ~3M–5M tokens/month over next 6 months as we onboard 2 new product teams; occasional daily peaks ~6M on high-usage days.

Target $/1M tokens and budget
- Our finance lead is aiming for ~ $750–$950 / 1M tokens as a target range. We are flexible if a committed discount supports the lower end.
- Current procurement budget allocated: $12k–$20k/month for experimentation. Could increase to $30k+/mo if we lock a 12mo commitment with predictable pricing.

Commitment appetite
- We prefer starting with a 6–12 month committed tier if pricing is competitive; open to 24mo if there are multi-year incentives.

Attached: LumenAI scale projections (sheet includes month-by-month token estimate and current spend).

Sophie
Sophie Tran
Head of Platform, LumenAI
sophie@lumenai.com | +1 (415) 555-4820
[Attachment: lumenai-scale-projections.xlsx (Excel, 48KB)]
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Tran <sophie@lumenai.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Pricing options: starter credits, 12mo committed band, multi-year incentive (proposal attached)

Hi Sophie — thanks for the projection file, that helped. Attached is a short proposal with three scenarios and the modeled $/1M token at each tier. TL;DR (numbers are illustrative; we'll finalize once legal confirms billing cadence):

Option A — Starter (no long-term commit)
- Pay-as-you-go list with a one-time startup credit: $3,000 credit applied over first 3 months
- Effective early-stage price: ~$930 / 1M tokens on your projected mix

Option B — 12-month committed band
- Commit: 200M tokens over 12 months (16.7M tokens/mo avg)
- Discount: 30% off list; target effective price: ~$670 / 1M tokens
- Monthly invoicing (net 30) with quarterly usage true-up

Option C — Multi-year (24-month) incentive
- Commit: 400M tokens over 24 months
- Discount: 40% off list + 3-month startup credit; price cap guarantee: <= $650 / 1M tokens for term
- Option to pre-pay quarterly for an additional 2% off

Notes and asks:
- We modeled $/1M using your projected mix (baseline vs peak) — see attached PDF for the calc.
- If Procurement requires SOW before signature, we can provide a skeleton SOW and T&Cs.
- Can you confirm if LumenAI requires an annual PO or prefers monthly invoices for a committed plan? That will affect billing workflow.

Attaching: redwood-commit-options-avery.pdf (includes scenario math and a sample SOW skeleton).

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (888) 555-0199
[Attachment: redwood-commit-options-avery.pdf (PDF, 124KB)]
From: Sophie Tran <sophie@lumenai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, LumenAI Procurement <procurement@lumenai.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing options: starter credits, 12mo committed band, multi-year incentive (proposal attached)

Thanks Ben — this is helpful. A few quick follow-ups: 

1) Can you send me the line that shows effective $/1M at our projected mix (month 1 vs month 6)? I want to show it to Finance with the actual month-by-month numbers.
2) Procurement prefers a 12-month PO if we do committed. They will accept monthly invoices against a standing PO. Can you include preferred invoice cadence and payment terms in the SOW skeleton?
3) Are there any penalties for underuse against a commit band, or a true-up mechanism? Need clarity for our budgeting.

If you can send a short one-page summary with those three clarifications, I can loop Legal/Procurement and we can move to a draft PO next week.

Appreciate it — Sophie
